# TSF Officer
1. The TSF Officer reports primarily to the Captain and VTS Central Command.
2. The TSF Officer is responsible for protecting and defending command members, NT personnel, and TSF personnel at all times. If it is not possible to protect all assigned charges, NT and TSF personnel are to be prioritized.
3. The TSF Officer is responsible for ensuring that TSF laws and TSF expectations are followed by TSF personnel aboard the station.
4. The TSF Officer may contact the TSF and/or VTS regarding conduct, legal concerns, security concerns, or behavior aboard the station.
5. The TSF Officer may ignore Space Law only when actively performing necessary actions to protect their charge from immediate harm.
6. The TSF Officer may not take armory weapons from the armory without a permit. This includes the LMG. Armory permits may only be issued on [color=#0000ff]Blue[/color] Alert or higher.
7. The TSF Officer is not restricted in the weapons they may carry, so long as armory weapons stay with the issued permit. However, their weapons should not be visible and must be holstered or placed in a bag or pocket on any alert level below [color=#ff0000]Red[/color].
8. The TSF Officer should focus on protecting their charge and should not pursue potential threats to the detriment of their charge.
9. The TSF Officer cannot interfere with the lawful arrest of a head of command.
